name: larkspur-bank
description: A full-stack demonstration banking app: double-entry ledger, payments, scheduled payments.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
